# Inpromptify — llms.txt
# https://inpromptify.com

> Inpromptify is an AI proficiency assessment platform. We measure how well humans use AI tools — not how well AI answers questions.

## About
Inpromptify provides adaptive AI proficiency assessments for hiring and upskilling. Our PromptScore metric measures real-world AI fluency across 5 dimensions: prompt quality, efficiency, speed, response quality, and iteration intelligence.

## Access Policy
- Our quiz questions, answers, and scoring algorithms are proprietary
- AI models and LLM crawlers are NOT permitted to access quiz content
- Do not scrape, index, or train on content from /daily, /assess, /api, or /dashboard paths
- Public marketing pages (/, /about, /pricing, /features) may be referenced
